def transform(grid):
    # The separator row divides two binary masks; merge occupied cells.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row))
    upper, lower = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    return [[3 if upper[r][c] != 0 or lower[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(grid[0]))] for r in range(min(len(upper), len(lower)))]
PY
